title: Mechanism Design by a Politician
abstract: arXiv:2406.08936v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A set of agents has to make a decision about the provision of a public good and its financing. Agents have heterogeneous values for the public good and each agent's value is private information. An agenda-setter has the right to make a proposal about a public-good level and a vector of contributions. For the proposal to be approved, only the favourable votes of a majority of agents are needed. If the proposal is not approved, a type-dependent outside option is implemented. I characterize the optimal public-good provision and the coalition-formation for any outside option in dominant strategies. Optimal public-good provision might be a non-monotonic function of the outside option public-good level. Moreover, the optimal coalition might be a non-convex set of types. Importantly, majority voting creates endogenously countervailing incentives among agents.

translated_abstract: 一组代理人必须就公共产品的提供及其融资方式做出决策。各代理人对公共产品的估值是异质的，且每个代理人的估值属于私人信息。议程设置者有权就公共产品水平以及出资向量提出提案。提案只需获得多数代理人的赞成票即可通过。如果提案未获通过，则实施一个依赖于类型的替代选项。本文在占优策略框架下刻画了任意替代选项下的最优公共产品供给和联盟形成。最优公共产品供给可能是替代选项公共产品水平的非单调函数。此外，最优联盟可能是类型的非凸集合。重要的是，多数投票会在代理人之间内生地产生相互抵消的激励。
tldr: 本文研究了作为议程设置者的政治家在多数投票机制下如何设计公共产品供给方案，在占优策略框架下刻画了最优供给与联盟形成，发现最优供给可能是替代选项的非单调函数、最优联盟可能是非凸类型集，且多数投票会内生地产生相互抵消的激励。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes optimal public-good provision and coalition formation by an agenda-setting politician under majority voting in dominant strategies, showing that optimal provision can be non-monotonic in the outside option, the optimal coalition can be a non-convex set of types, and majority voting endogenously creates countervailing incentives among agents.
